_comment: Reference block for ~/.claude/settings.json — merge the `sandbox` key by hand or enable interactively with /sandbox. Commands run in bubblewrap (writes limited to the project, network through an allow-listed proxy); sudo/systemctl/podman are excluded and go through the normal permission prompt. Prerequisites on Ubuntu 26.04: bubblewrap + socat (installed by apply-system.sh); Ubuntu's bwrap AppArmor profile already permits user namespaces.
